subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

My most __vivid __recollection of that summer is the ocean.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vivid"** means something that is clear, detailed, and lively; it usually refers to strong, distinct, and striking impressions. (जीवंत)

 
 
• **Example: **Her description of the event was so **vivid **that I felt like I was there.
 
 
 
• **"Vague"** refers to something that is not clear, definite, or detailed; it is often ambiguous or indistinct. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **His memories of the place were** vague **and fragmented.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'vivid' **is **'vague'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eloquent **(प्रभावशाली): Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing.

 
 
• **Example:** The speaker was so **eloquent** that the audience was captivated.
 
 
 
• **Lucid **(स्पष्ट ): Clear and easy to understand.
 
 
• **Example: **The professor gave a **lucid** explanation of the complex theory.
 
 
 
• **Pictorial** (चित्रात्मक): Relating to or resembling pictures.
 
 
• **Example:** The book contains a **pictorial** history of the town.
